# Prosper or Perish - Noble investment.
# Nobles with surplus gold build peasant and labourer buildings for goods their markets are short of, the most profitable
# first (scripted_effects/pp_noble_investment_effects.txt, generated by scripts/generate_noble_investment.py).
#
# A pulse script, against the "no further pulse scripts" note in pp_stored_food.txt: the engine keeps one planned
# project per estate and nothing steers what it plans (docs/ai_building_rulebook.md, section 3), so there is no
# engine mechanism to hook. Kept cheap: the monthly pulse spreads the countries over the month, and a country only
# searches while its nobles hold more than the reserve; after a search it waits 90 days (built) or 180 days (nothing
# found) before the next one.

monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		delay = { days = { 0 29 } }
		pp_noble_investment_country
	}
}

# Country scope.
pp_noble_investment_country = {
	effect = {
		pp_noble_investment_monthly = yes
	}
}
